T: Zoo animals overboard. Buffet on the beach.
D: Four pampered zoo animals from New York end up shipwrecked on Madagascar.
P: Serve the steak when Alex starts seeing his friends as steaks.
S: Salmon and avocado rolls in nori, served with soy
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, spread on nori, filled with salmon and avocado, rolled tight with a mat, sliced with a wet knife, soy and pickled ginger alongside.
Island sweet potato fritters with mango salsa
Crisp spiced sweet potato fritters with a mango, chilli and lime salsa

Squeeze the grated sweet potato in a clean tea towel to dry it. Mix with the spring onions, eggs, flour, cumin and a good pinch of salt. Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil over medium heat, flattened, 3 minutes a side until crisp and cooked through. Drain on paper towel. Mix the mango, chilli, lime juice and chopped coriander with a pinch of salt. Serve the fritters hot with the salsa on top.
M: Pan seared rib eye with garlic parsley butter and fries
Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, pulled at 54C and rested 8 minutes, topped with garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries.
the fish Alex finally learns to eat on the island

Firm white fish simmered in a coconut, tomato and ginger curry with lime and chilli, served over rice with fresh coriander and toasted coconut. Soften 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil. Add 2 tsp mild curry powder and 1 tsp turmeric and stir 1 minute. Add 2 diced tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes. Slip in 800g firm white fish such as barramundi in chunks and poach gently for 6 minutes. Finish with lime juice and salt. Serve over rice with coriander and toasted coconut flakes.
W: Grilled pineapple wedges in brown sugar caramel butter

Thick pineapple wedges grilled until charred and glazed in a brown sugar, butter and lime caramel, with coconut ice cream and toasted coconut. Cut 1 pineapple into 8 long wedges and grill on a hot pan or barbecue for 3 minutes a side until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar, bubble for 2 minutes, then stir in the juice of a lime and a pinch of salt. Toss the pineapple in the caramel. Serve warm with scoops of coconut ice cream and toasted coconut flakes.
Chocolate brownies swirled with cream cheese stripes
Brownie batter and cheesecake batter swirled into black and white stripes, baked at 170C for 30 minutes.
K: Mango, pineapple, passionfruit and lime over crushed ice

Mango nectar, passionfruit pulp, pineapple and lime topped with fizzing lemonade, served by the jug over crushed ice with fruit floating on top. In a large jug stir 600ml mango nectar, 300ml pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add diced mango and pineapple and plenty of crushed ice. Top with 600ml chilled lemonade just before serving and pour into tall glasses with a lime wedge.
